Group Risk Management Policy

GRP-POL-001|Version6.0|Internal

## 13.5 Quality standards

•The assessment is performed by those who operate the process,facilitated but not authored by the riskfunction.

* Controls are described by what they do, who performs them, how often and what evidence they leave, not by policy name.

¢ Every risk rated Elevated or above has at least one key control mapped to it.

* Copy-forward of the previous cycle's assessment without review is not permitted and will be rejected on challenge.

•Where the same risk appears in multiple scope units,ratings are reconciled before submission.

## 13.6Attestationobligation

The accountable executive attests in writing that the assessment is complete and accurate to the best of their knowledge, that identified control weaknesses have been raised «& issues, and that no known risk has been omitted. Attestation may not be delegated below the accountable executive. Knowingly false attestation is a disciplinary matter and, for material risk takers, is reportable to the Remuneration Committee.

## 13.7Second-line challenge

The Group Risk function reviews every submitted RCSA and records its challenge, which may include disputing a rating, disputing a control effectiveness assessment, or requiring additional risks to be added. Where challenge is unresolved between the first and second line, the matter escalates to the Divisional Risk Committee and, if still unresolved, to the Group Executive Risk Committee. Unresolved challenge is reported to the Board Risk Committee quarterly.

## 13.8 Control evidence from platform configuration

Where a control is system-enforced, the configuration screen is acceptable evidence of design, provided the capture is dated and shows the production tenant. Such captures frequently contain the personal data of account holders and must be handled under Section 3.5 before any onward distribution.
